glosses: Of or related to a five-year period.

examples.text: By a singular coincidence, the great master of the Dorian lyre was born during the celebration of the Pythia, the quinquennial festival of Apollo[…]
The best data that BEA have come from the quinquennial censuses of business; these are used to “benchmark” the national accounts every five years and to compute new input-output tables.

glosses: Synonym of quinquennium, a five-year period.
Synonym of quinquennalia, the festival and religious ritual held in the 5th year of a Roman emperor's reign.
